# From Stylish Handbags, Travel Luggage To Clutches, These Top Bag Stores In Pune Have It All!

[![Sanaa Nalwalla](https://im.whatshot.in/img/user/2017/May/1494919917-16903503-10154409058292896-6340001259948068577-o.jpg)](https://www.whatshot.in/author/sanaanalwalla)

[Sanaa Nalwalla](https://www.whatshot.in/author/sanaanalwalla) Updated On Nov 5, 2020, 2:03 AM

![bookmark](https://www.whatshot.in/images/desktop/svg/bookmark-social.svg)

- ![From Stylish Handbags, Travel Luggage To Clutches, These Top Bag Stores In Pune Have It All!_0](https://im.whatshot.in/img/2020/Nov/zinnia-cropped-1604496492.jpg?w=740&h=397&q=80&wp=1)


1 of 5

## Discover with

FamilyFriendsCoupleKidsSingle

Unlike Zindagi Na Milenge Dobara, you don't need to spend a bomb on a bag to find yourself a new bagwati. Instead, we have found the top go-to spots in Pune for bag shopping that carry the right kind of luggage. If you know what I mean! \*wink wink\*

### The Bag Studio

![The Bag Studio](https://im.whatshot.in/img/2020/Nov/img-20200115-162638-cropped-1604496986.jpg?wp=1)

[The Bag Studio](https://www.whatshot.in/pune/find-everything-in-the-world-of-bags-at-the-bag-studio-starting-rs-350-v-158115) located on the ground floor of Royale Heritage Mall stores everything possible in the world of bags, from sling bags to handbags from wallets to backpacks too! Find adorable and stylish bags just for kids and funky coin purses/pouches to keep all your _chillar_ in starting Rs 350. Get your hands on leather laptop bags in beige, tan, browns and black for dotting office goers. Did we mention, they're unisex too! Brand conscious kinds? Pick from popular brands like Baggit, Lavie, Caprese and Wildcraft to name to a few.

**Where:** Dorabjee Royale Heritage Mall, Ground Floor, NIBM Road, Mohammed Wadi

**Contact:** 8308952534

### Navkar Bags

![Navkar Bags](https://im.whatshot.in/img/2020/Nov/navkar-cropped-1604496560.jpg?wp=1)

In the mood for some bag shopping without going broke? Head to the iconic [Navkar Bag](https://www.whatshot.in/pune/explore-the-massive-collection-of-bags-at-navkar-bag-and-satisfy-your-inner-bagaholic-v-156647) in Viman Nagar which has everything someone obsessed with bags could ask for. The offshoot of the parent brand in Narayan Peth and Laxmi Road, they have everything from pretty purses and elegant wallets to huge trolley bags and duffle bags. You can score some gorgeous bags for all utilities. The price range of backpacks starts from Rs 500 onwards. As you enter the store, you will find an entire wall presenting the variety of purses they have for women. Their cloth made tote bags go well with the day-today. Do check out the cutesy little tiffin covers will catch your eye while you shop there.

**Where:** Shop No 2, Viman Pride Society Opposite Lunkad Dreamland (Next to Airtel Store), Clover Park, Viman Nagar, Clover Park, Viman Nagar

**Contact:** 9096881639

### Zinnia

![Zinnia Bags](https://im.whatshot.in/img/2020/Nov/zinnia-cropped-1604496492.jpg?wp=1)

All you bagaholics, starting from totes, handbags, sling bags and clutches to suitcases, duffle bags and more, you name it and [Zinnia on FC Road](https://www.whatshot.in/pune/if-bags-are-your-first-love-then-you-need-to-check-out-zinnia-on-fc-road-v-158618) has it all. The store has two entire walls studded with chic, functional, trendy and classy handbags in different shapes and sizes. What caught our eye were the plaid bags which can elevate a plain outfit with just the right amount of panache. Make a beeline and get your hands on cute totes, backpacks and bucket bags as well and don’t worry, the price of these bags start at Rs 600 and go up to Rs 1000. You can score Louis Vuitton inspired trolley bags from Zinnia too. They come in three size variations available and cost about Rs 7000 onwards. So bag this opportunity of indulging in retail therapy now!

**Where:** Shop No 22, Sagar Arcade, Goodluck Chowk, FC Road

**Contact:** 02066439151

### Her & She

![Her n she ](https://im.whatshot.in/img/2020/Nov/she-n-her-1604496668.jpg?wp=1)

Located in Aundh, and two other branches in PCMC; [Her & She](https://www.whatshot.in/pune/50-discount-on-bags-at-this-aundh-store-c-14455) has been in business for four years now. They sell everything ranging from elegant pew leather purses in various colours which are perfect for an office day, to ornate _potlis_ with _zari_ embellishments apt for any _shaadi_ function big or small. Also pick from their collection of clutches that includes fancy party-wear clutches and their collection of everyday use, oversized totes (with tiny zipper pouches inside).  But what we love the most, are their backpacks! If you’re looking for quirky backpacks with blingy sequins and funny patchwork, you can buy them for as low as Rs 650 after discount.

**Where:** 170, Nagras Chowk, Opposite Comfort Furniture, Aundh

**Contact:** 9850444959
